newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S&P assigns AAA rating to SMHL No.4 Fund.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S&P assigns AAA rating to SMHL No.4 Fund.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Friday it assigned a AAA rating to the A$180 million mortgage-backed bonds issued by the Superannuation Members' Home Loans Programme Securitisation Fund No. 4.

S&P said the rating reflects the credit quality of the assets of the fund, the primary mortgage insurance provided by the Housing Loans Insurance Corp (HLIC), the maintenance of a minimum level of cash collateral, and the sound legal structure of the transaction.
HLIC's insurance obligations are guaranteed by the Australian government, which has a AAA local currency rating.
